what: The source of SkinTone34's body (Phase27 27.4): an image model's picture of hm08 shown four times (front, profile, back, profile), fitted and projected onto the body island, with the skin finer than 2 mm from 18 close pictures; turned into melanin and blood on the skin maker's model (tools/converters/fit/project_body.py, then gen_skin_maps.py --subject Tone34 --pigments). The face is SkinTone34_face.json's; the hands and the groin are the maker's.
picture_not_committed: RD-P27-3: no picture of an unclothed person is committed to this public repository. Every picture is instead remade by the chain below and checked by its pixels; all 19 regenerated pixel-identical on 2026-11-03 (Phase27 27.4).
pixels_sha256_is: sha256 of the RGB array's bytes (rows top to bottom, 8 bits a channel): a regeneration is checked by pixels, since a PNG encoder may write the same pixels as different bytes

model.name: Krea 2 Turbo (krea/Krea-2), the Comfy-Org ComfyUI repack in FP8
model.outputs: owned by whoever generates them; Krea claims no ownership (the licence's section 5.3), so the pictures are dedicated CC0 here
model.conditions_met_when_made: as SkinTone34_face.json; asking the model for unclothed bodies in this public CC0 library approved by the maintainer (2026-11-02, Phase27); whether the model writes a watermark is unverified (F-AIS-3)

generation.runner: ComfyUI 0.43.2, over its API (project_body.py paint and close paint; standard library only)

four_views.source: project_body.py prep (hm08 four times in one picture, Tone34's maker colour)

close.source: project_body.py close prep --atlas D_seam9.png (hm08 through 18 close cameras wearing the four views' body as at 27.2.1)

generation.regenerated: 2026-11-03: all 19 pictures pixel-identical to those first made on 2026-11-02, their renders byte-identical (Phase27 27.4); D_seam9 (the close cameras' atlas) remade texel-identical by the chain's fourth line

chain: uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_body.py fit <d> f4_s50_seed7.png
uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_body.py put <d> f4_s50_seed7.png seam9 --delight --level --head library/parity/P25_Head/D_struct2.png
uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_body.py close prep <d> --atlas <d>/D_seam9.png
uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_body.py fit <d> f4_s50_seed7.png --front-pins

uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_body.py put <d> f4_s50_seed7.png kl3 --fit-suffix _pins --delight --keep-colour --light-order 1 --level --level-lum --light-blur 0.02 --outline-clear 3 --smooth-holes --neck-fill --jaw-free --head library/parity/P25_Head/D_struct2.png
uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_body.py close put <d> --atlas <d>/D_kl3.png --tag kl3f

uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_body.py pigments <d>/D_kl3f.png --base library/parity/P25_Head/D_struct2.png --head-field library/parity/P25_Head/field_corner2_4k --c-fields library/parity/P25_Fields --out <field1>

uv run --with scipy tools/converters/fit/project_body.py pigments <d>/D_kl3f.png --base library/parity/P25_Head/D_struct2.png --head-field library/parity/P25_Head/field_corner2_4k --c-fields library/parity/P25_Fields --out <field> --correct-from <s1>
chain_notes: MATTER_SKIN_N=2048 for every project_body.py step (its default). D_struct2.png is Phase25's head as served at 8K (project_face.py structure); the served head is now 4K and matches it at the neck within 0.6 % (27.3).
